game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Portability
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Moss Door Chamber.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Case 4: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Portability.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Infinite Loop Trap' (Week 4 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Moss Door Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
